verdict.rationale: Bento documents outbound webhooks only as a workflow "Send webhook" action, which notifies an external system when an automation reaches that step, with Liquid-templated payloads drawn from person, event, site, or workflow context (bento-docs-15, bento-docs-30, bento-docs-57). Nothing shows a native subscription to delivery and engagement events, and nothing shows a fixed documented payload schema or request signing. missing for 10: native webhook subscriptions for sends/opens/clicks/bounces/unsubscribes, evidence that workflows can trigger on those email events, a documented fixed payload schema, signed payloads/signature verification, independent corroboration.
